ja: 今日私がやらなきゃいけないのは、洗濯物をたたむことだよ。
en: What I have to do today is fold the laundry.
alternatives: What I need to do today is fold the laundry.
The thing I have to do today is fold the laundry.
point: What I have to do is の後は動詞の原形で OK

ja: 今度の土曜日、僕たちはガレージを掃除するつもりだよ。
en: We're going to clean the garage this Saturday.
alternatives: We're going to clean out the garage this Saturday.
We're cleaning the garage this Saturday.
We plan to clean the garage this Saturday.
point: 前から決めている予定は be going to

ja: お母さん、弟に部屋を片付けるように言ってくれる？
en: Mom, can you tell my brother to clean his room?
alternatives: Mom, could you tell my brother to clean his room?
Mom, can you tell my brother to tidy up his room?
Mom, will you tell my brother to clean up his room?
point: tell + 人 + to do の語順。that 節にしない

ja: 夫はゴミを出すのを忘れてたけど、もう出してくれたよ。
en: My husband forgot to take out the trash, but he's done it now.
alternatives: My husband forgot to take the trash out, but he's done it now.
My husband forgot to take out the garbage, but he's already done it.
point: 忘れたのは過去形、今は済んだ状態なので現在完了

ja: ねえ、掃除機がどこにあるか知ってる？
en: Do you know where the vacuum cleaner is?
alternatives: Do you happen to know where the vacuum is?
Any idea where the vacuum cleaner is?
point: 間接疑問は where the vacuum cleaner is の語順

ja: 姉はさっき洗剤を買いにスーパーへ行ったよ。
en: My sister just went to the supermarket to buy detergent.
alternatives: My sister went to the supermarket a little while ago to buy detergent.
My sister just went to the store to buy detergent.
My sister just went to the supermarket to get detergent.
point: 目的の「〜しに」は to + 動詞の原形で表す
